app_fee.value: No application fee at EPFL (enrolment fees apply later).
app_fee.quote: No, there is no application fees

fee_waiver.value: Not needed: there is no application fee.
fee_waiver.quote: No, there is no application fees

gre_general.value: GRE General is not required but recommended; individual doctoral programs may differ (see program records).
gre_general.quote: The results of the GRE general test is not required but recommended.

toefl_min.value: As a general rule the Doctoral School asks for no TOEFL, but a program may require one or weigh it; check the program record. TOEFL is strongly recommended for non-native speakers.
toefl_min.quote: As a general rule, the EPFL Doctoral School does not require GRE, TOEFL or IELTS results.

also.quote: we strongly recommend that they provide us with the results of the TOEFL and/or GRE test.

ielts_min.value: As a general rule the Doctoral School asks for no IELTS; a specific program may require it.
ielts_min.quote: As a general rule, the EPFL Doctoral School does not require GRE, TOEFL or IELTS results.

english_waiver.value: The Doctoral School does not say whether an English-medium degree from India replaces a test; it only requires proficiency in English.

notes: All PhD candidates apply through the central EPFL Doctoral School form to one of the doctoral programs (EDxx); each program sets its own deadlines and may add its own test rules.
